title: Web roster, presence and cursors
goal: Web users see who is in the session, what they are doing and where their cursors are, with identity never carried by colour alone and presence treated strictly as best-effort.
scope_in: Roster in apps/web/src/presence/: presence stack in the header (<= 5 avatars then `+N`, 32 px square, -8 px overlap), roster popover with avatar, name, role chip (HOST/EDIT/VIEW), colour name, activity ('typing', 'reviewing diff', 'away 4m'), nudge button.
Presence publisher: `presence.update {status, activity, agent_count?}` on change at most once per second; `away` after 5 min without input; typing debounce 400 ms; `busy` user-chosen.
Cursor layer: render remote `presence.cursor` (encrypted) as 4x6 pixel arrows with name tags over code/diff views, tags fade to 40 % after 3 s idle and vanish after 10 s; own cursor unlabelled.
Slot to colour mapping and join/leave toasts ('Maya joined'), avatar enter `base` 160 ms/`enter` and leave `slow` 280 ms/`exit`.
scope_out: TUI cursors (C077) and presence client in packages/net (C059).
Role changes/kick UI actions beyond showing the chips (handled with C083 host controls).
Read receipts (off by default, not built).
build_against: Mock backend (lane C007) emitting roster, member_joined/left, presence.update and presence.cursor at 10 Hz for 8 members.
interfaces: export function PresenceStack(props: {members: RosterEntry[]; max?: number}): JSX.Element
export function RosterPopover(props: {members: RosterEntry[]; self: MemberId; onNudge?(m: MemberId): void}): JSX.Element
export function CursorLayer(props: {cursors: ReadonlyMap<MemberId, CursorState>; roster: RosterEntry[]; container: RefObject<HTMLElement>}): JSX.Element
export function usePresencePublisher(): {setActivity(a: 'idle'|'typing'|'reviewing'|'running'): void; setStatus(s: 'online'|'away'|'busy'): void}
slotToColour(slot: number, selfSlot: number): CentoColour  // same rule as C077, local copy
acceptance: Presence dot colours: online `status.success`, away `status.warning`, offline `border.strong`, busy `status.danger`, each with a distinct glyph shape (check, clock, dash, minus) and an accessible name ('Maya, online').
Initial text is white on violet and brown, ink-900 on red, yellow, green (DESIGN.md 4.6); brown avatars have the 1 px abyss-300 ring; contrast test passes >= 3:1 on every pair.
Publisher never exceeds 1 presence.update/s and 10 presence.cursor/s under a synthetic 100 events/s input; typing indicator clears 5 s after the last keystroke.
A remote cursor idle 3 s drops to 40 % opacity and is removed at 10 s; on member_left it is removed immediately.
Sixth participant renders violet with an outline and a distinct initial; roster text reads 'M · Maya · green'.
Roster popover is a focus-trapped dialog with Esc to close and returns focus to the trigger; stack has `aria-label="Participants, N online"`.
Join and leave announce via aria-live polite ('Maya joined'); toasts with no action auto-dismiss at 4 s; no solo-session typing indicators.
tests: presence.slots.test.ts: colours for slots 0-7 and self offset.
guardrails: MUST NOT make any feature depend on a presence frame being delivered (best-effort).
MUST NOT send cursor path or text in `p`; cursor payload is encrypted only.
Nudges: rate limit one per person per minute client-side, always dismissible, and sent with existing frames only (see notes).
MUST NOT identify people by colour alone; name + initial always present (DESIGN.md 16.3).
failure_modes: Presence frame for unknown member -> hold up to 10 s for roster, then drop.
Roster version gap (control.roster.version jumps) -> trust the newest full roster; discard partials.
Clock skew -> use local receive time for fade/expiry, never frame `ts`.
